name: IFC Diff
description: Compare two IFC files in the workspace by GlobalId: elements added, removed and changed (class, name, property sets and quantities), with counts and capped samples. Geometry is not compared. Read-only.
author: AEC Model Bridge

older_ifc_path.description: Path of the earlier .ifc file, inside the workspace.

newer_ifc_path.description: Path of the later .ifc file, inside the workspace.

ifc_class.description: Optional IFC class (for example IfcWall) to compare, with its subclasses. Default: every IfcProduct.

max_items.description: Most elements listed per section; counts are always complete.
